question.problem:
Consider the bilinear form $B(x,y),$ given by 

$$
B(x,y)=2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}-{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-{x}_{2}{y}_{2}.
$$

  

Evaluate $B(x,y)$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$\,$ $x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,y=[\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$

Substituting these into the bilinear expression, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}-{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+3{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =2\cdot (-1)\cdot (-2)-2\cdot (-2)+3\cdot (-1)\cdot 1-2\cdot 1 \\  & =4+4-3-2 \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
